blind_target.outcome_quote: Results revealed a pattern similar to the one found by Espin et al. with approximately 18% of the content of practitioner articles on CBM devoted to the topic of decision-making. While, in their review of CBM PD materials, Espin et al. found the greatest proportion of attention was given to conducting CBM (53%) followed by general CBM information (24%), in the case of practitioner journal content, the greatest proportion of text was devoted to general CBM information (42.16%) followed by information on conducting CBM (39.29%).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The central underrepresentation of DBDM agrees, but the authors explicitly contrast the relative ordering of the other tested content categories and describe another difference in the Other category. The abstract comparison confirms a particular pattern; it is not an overall verdict encompassing all category comparisons. New sampled practitioner articles make this an empirical content-analysis replication despite the systematic-review title.

shipped.title_o: The Development of Regulatory Functions From Birth to 5 Years: Insights From Premature Infants
shipped.outcome_quote: This study replicated and extended the Feldman (2009) study by applying the developmental hierarchical-integrative model to understand the emergence of self-regulation.

blind_target.authors: Feldman R
blind_target.title: The development of regulatory functions from birth to 5 years: Insights from premature infants.
blind_target.evidence_quote: This analytic step was a confirmatory effort to replicate Feldman's (2009) findings, on top of which we included the estimation of stability paths over time to provide more robust findings.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Our first hypothesis was to replicate Feldman's (2009) model that established the developmental pathway of physiological regulation before age 1 → emotion regulation before age 1 → attention regulation between age 1-2 → self-regulation at age 5. In contrast, our study identified three major pathways: attention regulation at 6 months predicted physiological regulation at 15 months, attention regulation at 15 months predicted emotion regulation at 24 months, and attention regulation at 24 months predicted better self-regulation (greater executive functions, compliance, and fewer behavioral problems) in preschool age. Our findings are consistent with Feldman's (2009) study in several ways. First, both the current study and Feldman's (2009) study support the conceptualization that the development of self-regulation is an ongoing process during early childhood.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Authors identify both agreement and explicitly contrasting pathways. Their opening statement that the study replicated the earlier study describes the undertaking; favorable evidence for the model is not an unqualified overall replication verdict. Explicit differences in sequential pathways and support for attention regulation make the aggregated outcome mixed.

shipped.title_o: ICD-11 PTSD and complex PTSD in treatment-seeking Danish veterans: a latent profile analysis
shipped.outcome_quote: The results replicate findings from our previous study that also identified distinct profiles of ICD-11 PTSD and CPTSD.

blind_target.authors: Folke, S., Nielsen, A. B. S., Andersen, S. B., Karatzias, T., & Karstoft, K. I.
blind_target.title: ICD-11 PTSD and complex PTSD in treatment-seeking Danish veterans: A latent profile analysis.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Here, we present a replication of Folke et al. (2019) and aim to identify distinct symptom profiles of PTSD and CPTSD using the ITQ in a new sample of previously deployed treatment-seeking soldiers.
blind_target.outcome_quote: In our 2019-study, we found that less ACE increased the likelihood membership of PTSD-class membership compared to CPTSD-class membership. This was not replicated in the current study, which could be a result of our smaller sample size.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The discussion confirms the PTSD, CPTSD, DSO and low-symptom profiles, but explicitly states the childhood-adversity predictor did not replicate. The abstract and conclusion confirm specific class findings, rather than giving an overall verdict covering all three stated hypotheses.

shipped.title_o: Actions really do speak louder than words—but only implicitly: Young children's understanding of false belief in action
shipped.outcome_quote: We successfully replicated the original findings: children's looking and interactive behaviour differed according to the agent's true or FB.

blind_target.authors: Garnham WA, Perner J.
blind_target.title: Actions really do speak louder than words – but only implicitly: young children's understanding of false belief in action.
blind_target.evidence_quote: In summary, we devised a conceptual replication and theoretically motivated extension of the original study of Garnham & Perner [34] because this type of task allowed us to do several crucial things at once: to combine different implicit measures (anticipatory looking and interactive), to add a crucial ignorance condition, and to compare children's performance with a standard FB task—all of which together make this task particularly informative.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Overall, our findings thus show that the results of Garnham & Perner [34] are robust and reliable: for different types of measures (anticipatory looking and interactive behaviour), young children who do not yet master standard FB tasks responded differentially according to the agent's true or false belief. However, the additional results from a new IG control condition suggest that the replicated pattern of findings (in TB versus FB conditions) does not necessarily reveal full-fledged belief understanding.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The findings replicate, but the central validity investigation indicates that the measures can reflect perceptual access/ignorance tracking rather than the purported belief understanding. This is a central message, not a minor limitation.

shipped.title_o: Polymorphism at the TNF superfamily gene TNFSF4 confers susceptibility to systemic lupus erythematosus
shipped.authors_o: Graham; Graham; Manku; Wong; Whittaker; Gaffney; Moser; Rioux; Altshuler; Behrens; Vyse
shipped.outcome_quote: This first replication study confirms the association of genetic variation in the upstream region of TNFSF4 with susceptibility to SLE.

blind_target.authors: Graham DS, Graham RR, Manku H, Wong AK, Whittaker JC, Gaffney PM
blind_target.title: Polymorphism at the TNF superfamily gene TNFSF4 confers susceptibility to systemic lupus erythematosus
blind_target.evidence_quote: A recent study demonstrated the association of TNFSF4 haplotypes located in the upstream region with risk for- or protection from Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) (Graham et al, 2008). In order to replicate this association, five single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) tagging the previously associated haplotypes and passing the proper quality control filters were tested in 1312 cases and 1801 controls from Germany, Italy, Spain, and Argentina.
blind_target.outcome_quote: The association of TNFSF4 with SLE was replicated in all the sets except Spain. There was a unique risk haplotype tagged by the minor alleles of the SNPs rs1234317 (pooled OR=1.39, p=0.0009) and rs12039904 (pooled OR=1.38, p=0.0012). We did not observe association to a single protective marker (rs844644) or haplotype as the first study reported; instead, we observed different protective haplotypes, all carrying the major alleles of both SNPs rs1234317 and rs12039904.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The paper explicitly confirms the risk association but contrasts its protective-haplotype result with the original, and reports no replication in Spain. General confirmation of genetic susceptibility is a specific positive comparison rather than an overall verdict resolving the expressly discordant protective finding.

parent_triage.reason: 24 source-triaged full-text outcome differences; retained every unresolved field per work. Distinguish central versus exploratory contrasts, whole-report verdict versus effect-specific confirmation, original-data recovery versus new-period findings, and invalid-method critique versus ordinary limitations. Source quotes checked; two blind quotes fail literal matching and require fresh source support, never repair. No confidence gate.
